Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Damaged item:
• Report it within 7 days of delivery.
• Send photos of the damaged item, the package, and the packing slip.
• Keep the item in the condition you received it.
• The case is reviewed and a resolution may be arranged after verification. 
Normal return (change of mind):
• Not accepted once the order has been delivered.
• Alcohol purchases generally cannot be returned due to regulations.  
So damaged shipments are treated as a shipping issue, while regular returns are not accepted after delivery.
